name: Salmon salad
summary: Gỏi cá hồi is salmon salad, served by the Silver Waterfall restaurant and on several town menus.
howToEat: Order it alongside the hotpot or the grilled salmon.
where: Nhà hàng thác Bạc near the falls gate, Indigo on Đổng Lợi, and Cá Hồi Vua on Lê Văn Tám. Anh Dũng on Xuân Viên lists it at 300,000 đồng.
seoTitle: Salmon salad in Sapa — the falls and the town
seoDescription: Gỏi cá hồi at the Silver Waterfall restaurant, Indigo, Cá Hồi Vua, and Anh Dũng in Sa Pa.
